properties.name: Minimum Age
properties.description: Enter the lowest age restriction for your website visitors.

properties.name: Verification Method
properties.description: Choose the verification method you prefer. The available options are: providing the date of birth, providing year of birth or choosing yes/no answer.

properties.name: Date format
properties.description: Select the right date format - Auto, North America, Europe. With Auto, the date format will be pulled in from your browser

properties.name: Remember Visitor (Days)
properties.description: Set the number of days to remember a visitor's age, in order for the visitor not to undergo the verification process again on their next visit.

properties.name: Underage Action
properties.description: Select an action when a user's age is less than the lowest permitted age.

properties.name: Message
properties.description: Set a message to be displayed for underage visitors.
properties.defaultValue: You are not old enough to view this content

properties.name: Redirect URL
properties.description: Set the URL to redirect underage visitors to.

properties.name: Where to Display
properties.caption: This setting is used in case you've installed the widget to your website template, and it's available on each page of your website.
properties.description: Choose the pages where you need to enable age verification.

properties.name: Disable age verification for these pages
URL
properties.description: Set the URL of the page where you want to disable age verification.
List the pages where you want to disable age verification.

properties.name: Enable age verification only on these pages
URL
properties.description: Set the URl of the page that requires age verification.
List all the pages that require age verification.

properties.name: Message
properties.description: Let your visitors know how old they need to be to enter your website.
properties.defaultValue: You must be over 18 years old to visit this site.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Explain how your visitors can verify their age and let them know anything else they need before entering your website.
properties.defaultValue: Please, enter your date of birth

properties.name: Submit Button Text
properties.description: Set the text for the submit button.

properties.name: Yes Button Text
properties.description: Set the text for Yes button.

properties.name: No Button Text
properties.description: Set the text for No button.

properties.name: Additional Info (terms of entry, etc)
properties.description: Add any disclaimer, links to your terms of use or privacy policy, or any other relevant information. This information will be displayed in the bottom of the verification window.

properties.name: Logo
properties.description: Upload your logo picture to be displayed at the top of your verification window.

properties.name: Verification Window Image
properties.description: Upload an image to be displayed in your verification window. You can add any theme-related image.

properties.name: Overlay Background Image
properties.description: Upload a background image that will cover your website until a visitor passes age verification.

properties.name: Overlay Background Color
properties.description: Set the overlay background color.

properties.name: Popup Background Color
properties.description: Set the popup background color.

properties.name: Text Color
properties.description: Set the text color.

properties.name: Submit Button Color
properties.description: Set the submit button color.

properties.name: Yes Button Color
properties.description: Set Yes button color.

properties.name: No Button Color
properties.description: Set No button color.

properties.name: Message Font Size (px)
properties.description: Set the message font size in pixels.

properties.name: Text Font Size (px)
properties.description: Set the text font size in pixels.

properties.name: Additional Text Font Size (px)
properties.description: Set the additional text font size in pixels.
